messages:
noah: heads-up - Polaris POC is seeing auth failures + rate errors during a customer warmup. Demo in ~8h, customer is nervous. tagging @anya for auth triage.
anya: on it. which endpoints and error samples?
noah: /v1/chat returns mixed 401 and 429. sample from customer: `2026-03-24T09:12:01Z WARN auth: token invalid_claims aud mismatch` then `2026-03-24T09:12:07Z WARN rate_limiter: quota_exceeded account=polaris-team`. They spun up parallel workers for warmup.
marco: likely two independent issues: token audience mismatch from yesterday's issuer flip, and trial quota hitting per-account throttle during ramp. I can patch a short-lived aud-compat flag and apply a timeboxed quota override.
tara: customer will accept temporary fixes if we document rollback. Sales needs a quick note on pricing bump for quota override. @jen can you confirm how to record billable add-on?
jen: SalesOps: yes, timeboxed quota increases are billable. Log as 'pilot capacity addendum' and route invoice after demo. I'll send template.
anya: quick mitigation applied: aud-compat feature flag enabled in preprod; auth logs now show valid for mixed aud tokens.
marco: quota override applied for 4h window to allow ramp; monitoring graph shows 429s drop to 0.8% from 15%.
noah: action items: marco -> ensure override auto-reverts in 4h and open PR to remove compat in 7 days; anya -> follow up with JWKS rotation instructions to customer SRE; jen -> submit invoice addendum; tara -> notify exec sponsor. Keep updates here and ping if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
